claim: Injectisomes are multi-protein transmembrane machines allowing pathogenic bacteria to inject effector proteins into eukaryotic host cells through type III secretion.
source_text: Injectisomes are multi-protein transmembrane machines allowing pathogenic bacteria to inject effector proteins into eukaryotic host cells, a process called type III secretion.
evidence_reasoning: This is a definitional statement about injectisomes that draws from established scientific knowledge in the field.

claim: This study presents the first three-dimensional structure of Y. enterocolitica and S. flexneri injectisomes in situ.
source_text: Here we present the first three-dimensional structure of Yersinia enterocolitica and Shigella flexneri injectisomes in situ
evidence_reasoning: This claim is supported by the cryo-ET experimental data and structural reconstructions presented in the manuscript.

claim: This study presents the first structural analysis of the Yersinia injectisome.
source_text: Here we present the first three-dimensional structure of Yersinia enterocolitica and Shigella flexneri injectisomes in situ and the first structural analysis of the Yersinia injectisome.
evidence_reasoning: This claim is supported by the structural data obtained through cryo-ET and crystallography presented in the manuscript.

claim: Basal bodies of injectisomes inside bacterial cells showed length variations of 20%.
source_text: Unexpectedly, basal bodies of injectisomes inside the bacterial cells showed length variations of 20%.
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by MRA classification data showing intermembrane distances ranging from 30 to 36 nm.

claim: The in situ structures of Y. enterocolitica and S. flexneri injectisomes had similar dimensions.
source_text: The in situ structures of the Y. enterocolitica and S. flexneri injectisomes had similar dimensions
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by comparative measurements from cryo-ET reconstructions of both species.

claim: In situ injectisomes were significantly longer than isolated structures of related injectisomes.
source_text: The in situ structures of the Y. enterocolitica and S. flexneri injectisomes had similar dimensions and were significantly longer than the isolated structures of related injectisomes.
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by comparison of in situ cryo-ET data with published single particle EM structures.

claim: The crystal structure of YscD appeared elongated compared to a homologous protein.
source_text: The crystal structure of the inner membrane injectisome component YscD appeared elongated compared to a homologous protein
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by X-ray crystallography data comparing YscD to PrgH structure.

claim: Molecular dynamics simulations documented the elongation elasticity of YscD.
source_text: molecular dynamics simulations documented its elongation elasticity
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by steered MD simulations showing force-extension profiles and conformational changes.

claim: The ring-shaped secretin YscC at the outer membrane was stretched by 30-40% in situ compared to its isolated liposome-embedded conformation.
source_text: The ring-shaped secretin YscC at the outer membrane was stretched by 30–40% in situ, compared to its isolated liposome-embedded conformation.
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by comparison of in situ cryo-ET data with cryo-ET of isolated YscC in liposomes.

claim: Elasticity is critical for some two-membrane spanning protein complexes to cope with variations in the intermembrane distance.
source_text: We suggest that elasticity is critical for some two-membrane spanning protein complexes to cope with variations in the intermembrane distance.
evidence_reasoning: This is a hypothesis inferred from the observed structural flexibility and supported by osmotic stress experiments, but involves speculative reasoning about functional significance.

claim: The bacterial type III secretion apparatus allows Gram-negative bacteria to export effector proteins in one step across two bacterial membranes and a eukaryotic cell membrane.
source_text: The bacterial type III secretion apparatus, the injectisome, is a complex nanomachine that allows Gram-negative bacteria to export effector proteins in one step across the two bacterial membranes and an eukaryotic cell membrane
evidence_reasoning: This statement is supported by citations (Cornelis, 2006; Galan and Wolf-Watz, 2006) and represents established knowledge.

claim: The assembly of the injectisome involves approximately 34 different proteins.
source_text: The assembly of the injectisome involves some 34 different proteins.
evidence_reasoning: This is a statement of established knowledge about injectisome composition.

claim: Phylogenic analyses classify injectisomes into seven different families.
source_text: Phylogenic analyses based on the most conserved proteins classify injectisomes into seven different families (Ysc, Ssa-Esc, Inv-Mxi-Spa, Hrc1, Hrc2, Rhizobiales, and Chlamydiales)
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by citations to Pallen et al., 2005 and Troisfontaines and Cornelis, 2005.

claim: The injectisome consists of three parts: a hollow needle, a basal body, and a cytoplasmic part.
source_text: The injectisome consists of three parts: a ∼60 nm long, hollow needle protruding from the bacterial surface, a basal body that spans the two bacterial membranes and the periplasm, and a cytoplasmic part.
evidence_reasoning: This is a description of established structural organization of injectisomes.

claim: The basal body of Salmonella and Shigella injectisomes have been purified and structurally analyzed in great detail.
source_text: The basal body of the Salmonella enterica serovar Typhimurium SPI-I and Shigella flexneri injectisomes have been purified and structurally analyzed in great detail.
evidence_reasoning: This refers to prior published work on isolated injectisome structures.

claim: The barrel-shaped structure at the outer membrane consists of a 12-15 mer of a secretin family protein.
source_text: The barrel-shaped structure spanning the OM and protruding into the periplasm consists of a 12–15 mer of a protein from the secretin family (YscC, InvG, MxiD)
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by multiple citations to structural studies (Burghout et al., 2004; Marlovits et al., 2004; Hodgkinson et al., 2009; Spreter et al., 2009; Schraidt and Marlovits, 2011).

claim: The lipoprotein YscJ/PrgK/MxiJ is proposed to form a 24-subunit ring.
source_text: The lower double-ring reaching into the IM is made of a lipoprotein (YscJ, PrgK, MxiJ) proposed to form a 24-subunit ring
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by citations to multiple studies (Kimbrough and Miller, 2000; Crepin et al., 2005; Yip et al., 2005; Silva-Herzog et al., 2008; Hodgkinson et al., 2009).

claim: The injectisome is evolutionarily related to the bacterial flagellar motor system.
source_text: The injectisome is evolutionarily related to the bacterial flagellar motor system, with which it shares the basic type III secretion export apparatus
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by citations (Cornelis, 2006; Minamino et al., 2008; Erhardt et al., 2010) and represents established evolutionary knowledge.

claim: Cryo electron tomography was applied to visualize injectisomes in intact bacteria.
source_text: We applied cryo electron tomography (cryo-ET) to visualize injectisomes in intact
evidence_reasoning: This describes the experimental method used and is supported by the tomography data presented.

claim: The vertical distance between the centers of the membranes in the reconstruction is approximately 33 nm.
source_text: The vertical distance between the centers of the membranes in the reconstruction is ∼33 nm.
evidence_reasoning: This is a direct measurement from the cryo-ET reconstruction.

claim: The measured intermembrane distance is significantly larger than the approximately 20 nm expected from isolated basal body structures.
source_text: This average value is in the range of values reported for gram-negative bacteria (Chen et al., 2011; Liu et al., 2011; Wang et al., 2012), but significantly larger than the ∼20 nm expected from the structures of basal bodies isolated from Salmonella enterica SPI-I and S. flexneri
evidence_reasoning: This compares the measured data with published structures and other bacterial measurements.

claim: CEMOVIS imaging confirmed the intra-membrane distance measured in plunge-frozen samples.
source_text: Independent measurements made by imaging Y. enterocolitica cells by cryo-electron microscopy of vitreous sections (CEMOVIS) (Figure 2—figure supplement 2 and 'Materials and methods') and tomography on high pressure frozen and freeze substituted bacteria (data not shown) confirmed the intra-membrane distance.
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by independent CEMOVIS measurements showing similar intermembrane distances.

claim: The largest lateral diameter of the periplasmic part of the average injectisome structure is 18 nm.
source_text: Measuring from mass center to mass center, the largest lateral diameter of the periplasmic part of the average injectisome structure is 18 nm
evidence_reasoning: This is a direct measurement from the averaged cryo-ET structure.

claim: The largest diameter at the outer membrane is 12 nm.
source_text: The largest diameter at the outer OM is 12 nm (Figure 2—figure supplement 1E), which is in good agreement with the dimensions of isolated and liposome reconstituted YscC complexes
evidence_reasoning: This is a measurement from the cryo-ET structure that agrees with isolated YscC dimensions.

claim: A large ring-like structure can be discerned on the cytoplasmic side of the inner membrane.
source_text: Further, a large ring-like structure can be discerned on the cytoplasmic side of the IM (Figure 2A, yellow).
evidence_reasoning: This is an observation from the cryo-ET reconstruction.

claim: A smaller, torus-like structure localized approximately 5 nm underneath the membrane is tentatively proposed to be the export gate YscV.
source_text: It surrounds a smaller, torus-like structure localized ∼5 nm underneath the membrane, which we tentatively propose to be the export gate YscV (Figure 2A, red), based on the localization of the export gate protein FlhA of the flagella motor
evidence_reasoning: This is based on structural observation and inference from analogy to the flagellar motor system.

claim: Intermembrane distances in individual injectisomes ranged from 30 to 36 nm.
source_text: Classification by iterative multi reference alignment (MRA) of individual in situ Y. enterocolitica injectisomes revealed large variations in the length of the complex in the intermembrane space; intermembrane distances ranged from 30 to 36 nm
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by MRA classification analysis of cryo-ET sub-volumes.

claim: The basal body of the injectisome is highly flexible in the cellular context.
source_text: intermembrane distances ranged from 30 to 36 nm (Figure 2B–C), suggesting that the basal body of the injectisome is highly flexible in the cellular context.
evidence_reasoning: This is inferred from the observed length variations in the MRA classification data.

claim: The crystal structure of the first three periplasmic domains of YscD from Y. enterocolitica was determined.
source_text: In order to investigate the origin of the unexpected basal body flexibility observed by cryo-ET, we determined the crystal structure of the first three periplasmic domains of YscD from
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by X-ray crystallography data presented in the manuscript.

claim: YscD adopts a more extended conformation than its homologue PrgH.
source_text: Comparison of different conformers of YscD with the structure of PrgH
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by comparison of crystal structures shown in Figure 3A.

claim: YscD can undergo a maximal elongation of about 3.5 nm through tertiary structure elasticity.
source_text: Due to this tertiary structure elasticity, that is, the rearrangement of tertiary structure in response to mechanical force, the periplasmic domains of YscD can undergo a maximal elongation of about 3.5 nm (i.e., a 50% elongation compared to the compact conformation)
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by steered molecular dynamics simulation data.

claim: YscD opposes stretching with a force as small as 35 ± 15 pN per monomer.
source_text: while opposing the stretching with a force as small as 35 ± 15 pN per YscD monomer, a value that is comparable with that estimated for other highly stretchable multi-domain proteins
evidence_reasoning: This is calculated from steered MD simulations and compared to literature values.

claim: The tertiary structural elasticity of YscD significantly contributes to the overall elasticity of the basal body.
source_text: This suggests that the tertiary structural elasticity of the ring components of the periplasmic portion of YscD significantly contributes to the overall elasticity of the basal body of the injectisome in response to external forces.
evidence_reasoning: This is inferred from the MD simulation results showing YscD flexibility.

claim: A pseudo-atomic model of the inner membrane part of the basal body was constructed by combining experimental data with molecular modeling and simulations.
source_text: We constructed a pseudo-atomic model of the inner membrane part of the basal body by combining experimental data with molecular modeling and simulations
evidence_reasoning: This describes the integrative modeling approach combining cryo-ET, crystallography, and MD simulations.

claim: The YscD150-347 G283P mutant fully complements effector secretion in the ΔyscD strain.
source_text: Both constructs fully complement effector secretion in the ΔyscD strain.
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by the secretion assay data shown in Figure 3—figure supplement 3.

claim: The structure of isolated YscC reconstituted in liposomes was reconstructed at a resolution of approximately 3 nm.
source_text: we expressed and purified full-length YscC, reconstituted it into liposomes, and reconstructed its structure at a resolution of ∼3 nm by cryo-ET and sub-volume averaging
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by cryo-ET data of liposome-reconstituted YscC.

claim: The Shigella injectisome in situ appeared about 10 nm or approximately 40% longer than isolated structures.
source_text: the Shigella injectisome in situ appeared about 10 nm or ∼40% longer (32 nm vs 22 nm at the membrane level).
evidence_reasoning: This is based on comparison of in situ cryo-ET measurements with published isolated structures.

claim: Stretching of YscC by an estimated 5 nm and elongation of YscD by an estimated 3.5 nm would explain an approximately 8.5 nm overall extension of the basal body.
source_text: Stretching of YscC by an estimated 5 nm and an elongation of YscD by an estimated 3.5 nm would explain an ∼8.5 nm overall extension of the Yersinia injectisome's basal body
evidence_reasoning: This is calculated by combining the observed stretching of individual components.

claim: Y. enterocolitica bacteria placed into concentrated 10× PBS showed significantly increased intermembrane distances around basal bodies compared to 0.5× PBS.
source_text: Differences between 10× PBS and 0.5× PBS and between 10× PBS and PBS are significant (p=0.05 and p=0.02), while the difference between PBS and 0.5× PBS is not significant (p=0.6).
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by statistical analysis of cryo-ET measurements under different osmotic conditions.

claim: Exposure of Y. enterocolitica bacteria to osmotic stress from high salt conditions resulted in significant elongation of their basal bodies.
source_text: This is supported by our finding that exposure of the Y. enterocolitica bacteria to osmotic stress from high salt conditions resulted in a significant elongation of their basal bodies
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by cryo-ET measurements comparing bacteria in different PBS concentrations.

claim: The observed elasticity might allow the injectisome to better cope with membrane stresses.
source_text: We hypothesize that the here observed elasticity might allow the injectisome to better cope with such membrane stresses.
evidence_reasoning: This is a hypothesis about functional significance inferred from structural observations and osmotic stress experiments.

claim: The in situ reconstructions of the Yersinia and Shigella injectisomes show high overall similarity.
source_text: The in situ reconstructions of the Yersinia and Shigella injectisomes show high overall similarity considering the lower resolution of the Shigella injectisome: the overall dimensions, ring hierarchy and the peptidoglycan attachment location are conserved.
evidence_reasoning: This is based on comparison of the two in situ cryo-ET reconstructions.

claim: A significant difference was detected in the location of the torus ring assigned to the N-terminus of YscV/MxiA between Yersinia and Shigella injectisomes.
source_text: We could detect a significant difference in the location of the torus ring assigned to the N-terminus or YscV/MxiA (Abrusci et al., 2013). In the Yersinia injectisome, it was ∼5 nm below the membrane, while in the Shigella injectisome it was ∼10 nm below the membrane.
evidence_reasoning: This is based on measurements from the two in situ reconstructions.

claim: The in situ reconstructions of the Yersinia and Shigella injectisomes did not reveal obvious C-rings.
source_text: However, the in situ reconstructions of the Yersinia and Shigella injectisomes did not reveal obvious C-rings
evidence_reasoning: This is an observation from the cryo-ET reconstructions.

claim: YscQ may be unstructured or only transiently associated with the injectisome.
source_text: This could be caused by YscQ being unstructured, or being only transiently associated with the injectisome.
evidence_reasoning: This is speculative reasoning to explain the absence of visible C-rings in the reconstructions.

claim: The Y. enterocolitica injectisome reconstruction achieved a resolution of 4 nm.
source_text: Despite an observed length variation among Yersinia injectisomes, sub-tomogram averaging allowed reconstructing the needle systems at a resolution of 4 nm
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by FSC analysis of the cryo-ET reconstruction.

claim: A 24-meric YscD assembly is compatible with the basal body's diameter as observed by cryo-EM.
source_text: In particular, the 24-meric YscD assembly is compatible with the basal body's diameter, as observed by cryo-EM, while a higher number of YscD units would lead to a poorer match with the experimental data.
evidence_reasoning: This is based on fitting molecular models to the cryo-EM density map.

claim: The model constructed of 24 YscJ molecules does not produce gaps or overlaps in the final structural assembly.
source_text: the model constructed of 24 YscJ molecules does not produce gaps or overlaps in the final structural assembly, as we otherwise obtained when using a higher or lower stoichiometry.
evidence_reasoning: This is based on molecular modeling and fitting to the cryo-EM map.

claim: For fragile protein complexes that span two membranes, tertiary structure elasticity may constitute a general mechanism for structural protection.
source_text: We here hypothesize that for more fragile protein complexes that span two membranes, tertiary structure elasticity may constitute a general mechanism for structural protection.
evidence_reasoning: This is a broader hypothesis extrapolated from the specific findings about injectisome elasticity.

claim: Recent structural studies in situ revealed flexibility of large molecular complexes.
source_text: Recent structural studies in situ revealed flexibility of large molecular complexes.
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by citations to studies on type VI secretion systems, flagellar motors, and nuclear pore complexes.

claim: The bacterial type VI secretion system has two long lived states in the action cycle.
source_text: The bacterial type VI secretion system is reported have two long lived stated in the action cycle
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by citation to Basler et al., 2012.

claim: Bacterial flagellar motors of Borrelia burgdorferi partially lack the C-ring.
source_text: bacterial flagellar motors of Borrelia burgdoferii partially lack the C-ring
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by citation to Kudryashev et al., 2010.

claim: Protomers of nuclear pore complexes deviate from eightfold symmetry by up to 20% of the diameter.
source_text: Protomers of nuclear pore complexes deviate from eightfold symmetry by up to 20% of the diameter
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by citation to Beck et al., 2007.

claim: The injectisome needle is approximately 60 nm long.
source_text: a ∼60 nm long, hollow needle protruding from the bacterial surface
evidence_reasoning: This is a statement of established knowledge about injectisome structure.

claim: The basal body spans the two bacterial membranes and the periplasm.
source_text: a basal body that spans the two bacterial membranes and the periplasm
evidence_reasoning: This is a statement of established knowledge about injectisome structure.

source_text: Recent atomic models allowed a mechanistic understanding of the needle structure

claim: The basal body presents a barrel-shaped structure at the outer membrane with double ring-shaped densities underneath in the periplasmic space and inner membrane.
source_text: The basal body presents a barrel-shaped structure at the outer membrane (OM), with double ring-shaped densities underneath in the periplasmic space and the inner membrane (IM).
evidence_reasoning: This describes established structural features of the basal body from prior studies.

claim: YscD acts as a connector between the secretin and the inner membrane.
source_text: a protein that is not so conserved as the others, but shares a similar modular domain architecture and acts as a connector between the secretin and the IM (YscD, PrgH, MxiG)

claim: The crystal structure of the C-terminus of the export gate MxiA from S. flexneri revealed a ring arrangement.
source_text: The recent crystal structure of the C-terminus of the export gate of the cytoplasmic export apparatus MxiA from S. flexneri revealed a ring arrangement and allowed a mechanistic insight into secretion control
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by citation to Abrusci et al., 2013.

claim: The Y. enterocolitica injectisome has not been purified prior to this study.
source_text: At the same time we provide structural information for the intact Y. enterocolitica injectisome, which so far has not been purified.
evidence_reasoning: This is a statement about the prior state of knowledge in the field.

claim: The channel of the injectisome's needle is resolved at the outer membrane.
source_text: The channel of the injectisome's needle is resolved at the OM.
evidence_reasoning: This is an observation from the cryo-ET reconstruction.

claim: The density below the export gate likely corresponds to the YscN ATPase.
source_text: Similarly, in analogy to the flagellar motor system (Chen et al., 2011), the density below the export gate likely corresponds to the YscN ATPase.
evidence_reasoning: This is inferred by analogy to the flagellar motor system structure.

claim: Long and short classes of injectisomes had similar densities corresponding to the peptidoglycan layer.
source_text: Long and short classes had similar densities corresponding to the peptidoglycan layer.
evidence_reasoning: This is an observation from the MRA classification analysis.

claim: The three domains of YscD are arranged along a straight line.
source_text: The three domains are, in YscD, arranged along a straight line
evidence_reasoning: This is based on the crystal structure of YscD.

claim: The homologous PrgH protein adopts a more compact boot-shaped arrangement.
source_text: while the homologous PrgH protein adopts a more compact boot-shaped arrangement

claim: Both straight and bent structures constitute stable conformational states for the YscD protein.
source_text: The simulations showed that both straight and bent structures constitute stable conformational states for the YscD protein.
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by molecular dynamics simulation data.

claim: YscD showed the ability to explore a compact arrangement very close to the structure of PrgH.
source_text: Nonetheless, YscD showed the ability to explore a much compact arrangement, very close to the structure of PrgH.
evidence_reasoning: This is based on molecular dynamics simulations showing conformational flexibility.

claim: The application of stretching forces in MD produced an almost barrier-free transition from the compact to the extended conformation of YscD.
source_text: Moreover, the application of stretching forces in MD produced an almost barrier-free transition from the compact to the extended conformation
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by steered molecular dynamics simulation data.

source_text: Although the cryo-ET density could be optimally fitted only by extended forms similar to the X-ray YscD conformation

claim: Bacteria are likely exposed to considerable physical forces in vivo from swimming motions, contact with host cells, or changes in osmolarity.
source_text: Bacteria are likely exposed to considerable physical forces in vivo, originating from swimming motions, contact with host cells, or from changes in osmolarity of the surrounding medium.
evidence_reasoning: This is a statement based on general knowledge of bacterial physiology.

claim: Bacterial membranes must withstand distance variations while membrane proteins and complexes must continue to function.
source_text: For survival, the bacterial membranes must withstand distance variations, while membrane proteins and complexes must continue to function.
evidence_reasoning: This is a statement based on general principles of bacterial cell biology.

claim: It was recently suggested that injectisomes may rotate upon action.
source_text: Recently, it was suggested that injectisomes may rotate upon action (Ohgita et al., 2013), similarly to the evolutionary related flagellar motors.
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by citation to Ohgita et al., 2013.

source_text: Furthermore, the basal bodies of the bacterial flagellar motors do not seem to differ in dimensions between their isolated and in situ structures
evidence_reasoning: This is based on comparison with published flagellar motor structures (Chen et al., 2011).

claim: The stator rings of bacterial flagellar motors follow the curvature of the cytoplasmic membrane.
source_text: the stator rings follow the curvature of the cytoplasmic membrane
evidence_reasoning: This is supported by citation to Liu et al., 2009.

source_text: We here hypothesize that for more fragile protein complexes that span two membranes, tertiary structure elasticity may constitute a general mechanism for structural protection.
